koine's opinion as a posterior draws array (the stacking mixture)

Source: R/integration.R
koine_opinion_draws.Rd

Materialises koine's single synthesised opinion as an equal-weight posterior::draws_array over the parameters its contributing lenses share, by drawing from each retained lens in proportion to its LOO-stacking weight. This is the parameter-space representation a parent panel's parameter-marginal triangulation consumes. The stacking weights, the stacked predictive elpd, any per-lens parameters dropped from the shared set, and any scale parameters whose lens set was restricted ride along as attributes (koine_weights, koine_elpd_stacked, koine_dropped_vars, koine_scale_restricted).

Usage

koine_opinion_draws(result, n_draws = 4000L, seed = NULL)

Arguments

result

A koine_result produced with synthesise(pass, keep_fits = TRUE). A koine_abstention is returned unchanged (koine contributed no opinion to represent).

n_draws

Total draws in the returned mixture. Default 4000.

seed

Optional integer seed for the mixture sampling; defaults to a seed derived from the pass's content hash, so the representation is reproducible.

Value

A one-chain posterior::draws_array, or the input abstention.

Details

The mixture is over koine's own battery (a legitimate single opinion), never a pool across the parent's independent engines (charter SS4). Each parameter is mixed only over the lenses for which it is comparable: the linear-predictor coefficients (b_<col>) over every contributing lens, but a scale parameter (sigma, tau) only over the family-likelihood lenses — a likelihood-variant lens (the robust-t lens, which carries its own Student-t likelihood) reports its scale on a different metric, so it would bias the synthesised value if averaged in. The returned draws are therefore a per-parameter marginal representation (each column is its comparable-lens stacking mixture); the joint is approximate, which is exactly what a parameter-marginal triangulation needs.

See also

synthesise(), koine_can_contribute()

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = 1 + rnorm(80), x = rnorm(80))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
res <- synthesise(pass, keep_fits = TRUE)
if (!is_abstention(res)) {
  dr <- koine_opinion_draws(res)
  posterior::summarise_draws(dr, "mean", "sd")
}
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   variable        mean     sd
#>   <chr>          <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 b_(Intercept)  1.08  0.103 
#> 2 b_x           -0.289 0.0952
#> 3 sigma          0.875 0.0667
# }
